info.name: Perform a simple search for Visier document headers

params.name: q
params.description: The search query string. The results include document headers that match the search string. Search string is case-insensitive and supports partial matches. Search string must be at least 2 characters up to a maximum of 200 characters.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: The index to start retrieving results from, also known as offset. Defaults to 0.

items.docs:
Perform a simple search for Visier document headers, such as analysis titles. Simple search doesn't support keywords, Boolean expressions, or any other advanced search features. Example: `GET /v1alpha/search/simple/document-headers?q=My+Query&limit=10` returns the first 10 document headers that best match the query string `My Query`.
